paragraphs: Mentioned in [Ketubot 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.111a.21): he challenged Rabbi Ilaa’s statement, and Abaye answered his challenge. Hyman reports that Yuchasin reads R' Acha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman reports that Yuchasin gives Rabbi Acha.
The linked passage attributes the objection about rolling to Rabbi Abba Sala Rabba after Rabbi Ilaa’s statement. Abaye answers that tunnels are provided.
